_source: A real captured web-session ARIA snapshot (405 nodes, a marketing page with a sticky header nav and a long scrolling body), with every human-readable string replaced by a position token (n<preorder-key>). Structure, roles, flags, and bounds are verbatim from the capture: trailblazeNodeTree bounds come from the fuzzy role+name DOM walk (sparse), viewHierarchy bounds from the ref-resolved batched pass (dense). Regenerate by re-scrubbing any real web capture that logs both trees.
